# MMLAW Law Firm (mmlaw.ge)

> MMLAW is a criminal defence law firm in Georgia (office in Tbilisi) with more than 10 years of practice. Criminal law is its main practice: it defends accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims at every stage — from the first contact with the investigating authority, through interviews and questioning, investigative actions, preventive measures and trial (including jury trials) to the final decision of the Supreme Court. Areas include drug, property, economic, corruption, violent and cyber crimes, and juvenile cases. The firm also handles civil, administrative, labour, corporate, real estate, family, inheritance and intellectual property matters. Consultations in Georgian, English and Russian; the first consultation is free.

- Lawyer: Mariam Madzgharashvili (მარიამ მაძღარაშვილი). Lawyer, member of the Georgian Bar Association, specialising in criminal law, and a member of the Association's Jury Trial Committee. She focuses on criminal law, juvenile justice and children's rights, and holds a doctorate in law. Works in Georgian, English and Russian. Bar registry profile: https://gba.ge/en/Lawyers/Lawyer's%20Profile?lawyer=712
- Phone / WhatsApp: +995 551 00 43 00
- Email: info@mmlaw.ge
- Office: Tbilisi, Georgia. Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00
- Languages: Georgian (default, https://mmlaw.ge/ka/), English (https://mmlaw.ge/en/), Russian (https://mmlaw.ge/ru/)

## Website features

- Three languages: Georgian, English, Russian — every page exists in all three.
- Site search across all three languages (also finds Georgian words typed in Latin letters, e.g. "advokati").
- Text size control (A− / 100% / A+) on articles, practice-area and foreigner pages; the choice is remembered.
- "Listen": English and Russian pages can be read aloud with the device's built-in voice.
- Light and dark mode; works on phones with a bottom navigation bar (home, services, search, call).
- Contact: call, WhatsApp, or a call-back request form on every page.
- Every page has a clean Markdown copy: add index.md to its address (e.g. https://mmlaw.ge/en/criminal-defense-lawyer/index.md).
- Blog RSS feeds: https://mmlaw.ge/ka/blogi/feed.xml, https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/feed.xml, https://mmlaw.ge/ru/blog/feed.xml

## Practice areas

- [Criminal defense](https://mmlaw.ge/en/criminal-defense-lawyer/): MMLAW criminal defense lawyers represent accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims at every stage of a criminal case in Georgia — from the first contact with the investigating authority to the final decision of the Supreme Court.
- [Drug offences](https://mmlaw.ge/en/drug-crime-lawyer/): Drug crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims in drug-related criminal and administrative cases — from the first minute of an arrest or search.
- [Cybercrime](https://mmlaw.ge/en/cybercrime-lawyer/): We defend accused persons and witnesses in cybercrime cases in Georgia and help victims of online fraud, account hacking, blackmail and other digital harm.
- [Property crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/property-crime-lawyer/): Property crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims in cases of theft, robbery, fraud, extortion, embezzlement and misappropriation.
- [Economic crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/economic-crime-lawyer/): Economic crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend company directors, business owners and individuals against tax evasion, money laundering, customs violations and other economic charges.
- [Corruption and official crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/corruption-crime-lawyer/): Corruption crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend public officials, business owners and individuals in cases of bribery, trading in influence and abuse or excess of official power.
- [Violent crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/violent-crime-lawyer/): Violent crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend accused and convicted persons, witnesses and victims in cases of bodily injury, violence, threats and homicide, and we help victims.
- [Juvenile justice](https://mmlaw.ge/en/juvenile-justice-lawyer/): We defend children and young people in criminal and related proceedings under Georgia's Juvenile Justice Code, with a focus on rehabilitation and the child's best interests.
- [Civil litigation](https://mmlaw.ge/en/civil-litigation-lawyer/): We represent individuals and companies in civil disputes in Georgia — from pre-trial negotiation through all three court instances.
- [Administrative law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/administrative-law-lawyer/): We help individuals and businesses challenge unlawful decisions of public authorities and navigate licensing, permit and regulatory procedures in Georgia.
- [Labor disputes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/employment-lawyer/): We represent employees and employers in labour disputes under the Labour Code of Georgia — from unlawful dismissal to drafting contracts and workplace policies.
- [Corporate law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/corporate-lawyer/): Strategic legal support for businesses in Georgia — from company registration to mergers and acquisitions, compliance and restructuring.
- [Real estate](https://mmlaw.ge/en/real-estate-lawyer/): Full legal support for real estate in Georgia — checking the property, structuring and signing the deal, registering ownership and resolving disputes.
- [Family law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/family-lawyer/): Discreet, professional representation in divorce, child residence, alimony and division of marital property in Georgia.
- [Inheritance](https://mmlaw.ge/en/inheritance-lawyer/): We help you accept an inheritance in Georgia, obtain the certificate of inheritance and register the property in your name — and represent you in disputes between heirs.
- [Intellectual property](https://mmlaw.ge/en/intellectual-property-lawyer/): We protect brands, creative works and inventions — from registration with Sakpatenti to disputes with infringers.
- [Fraud](https://mmlaw.ge/en/fraud-lawyer/): In fraud cases we defend the accused and help victims get their money back — investment schemes, loans, online and crypto fraud, and business deals.
- [Financial crime victims](https://mmlaw.ge/en/financial-crime-victims/): Since 2025, victims of fraud, extortion, embezzlement and other financial crimes have a new, effective way to recover their losses. We use it for you — from the investigation to the money in your account.
- [Tax disputes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/tax-lawyer/): We represent you before the Revenue Service — during audits, when appealing a tax demand, when reducing tax debt and, if needed, in a criminal tax evasion case.
- [Money laundering](https://mmlaw.ge/en/money-laundering-lawyer/): A money laundering case often starts with a bank report or a frozen account. We defend individuals and companies — from proving the lawful origin of assets to the courtroom.
- [Asset freezing and confiscation](https://mmlaw.ge/en/asset-freezing-and-confiscation/): When the state freezes property or a bank account, or seeks confiscation, both business and family life stop at once. We challenge freezes, protect third parties' property and prove the lawful origin of assets.
- [Abuse of office](https://mmlaw.ge/en/abuse-of-office-lawyer/): We defend public officials, employees of public legal entities and company managers charged with abuse of official authority, exceeding authority or negligence.
- [Smuggling and customs](https://mmlaw.ge/en/smuggling-and-customs-lawyer/): We defend individuals and companies in cases of breaking the rules for moving goods across Georgia's customs border — from ordinary goods to jewellery and cultural heritage.
- [Director liability and insolvency](https://mmlaw.ge/en/director-liability-and-insolvency/): We defend company directors and partners — when the company is in debt, facing insolvency, or when a manager faces civil or criminal liability. We also protect creditors.

## For foreigners in Georgia

- [Legal help for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/): Moving to Georgia, buying property, starting a business or facing a legal problem here? We advise foreigners in English and Russian — at our Tbilisi office or remotely.
- [Criminal defense lawyer for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/criminal-defense-for-foreigners/): When a foreigner faces a criminal case in Georgia, language and unfamiliar procedure are the first obstacles. We defend you in English or Russian — from the moment of arrest to trial.
- [Immigration lawyer in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/immigration-lawyer-georgia/): When you are turned away at the border, have overstayed or face deportation, time is very short. We act from day one — in English or Russian, in Georgia or remotely.
- [Buying property in Georgia as a foreigner](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/buying-property-in-georgia/): Foreigners can buy apartments, houses and non-agricultural land in Georgia on the same terms as Georgians. We check the property, prepare the contract and register your ownership — even if you are abroad.
- [Disputes with property developers in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/disputes-with-developers/): When you buy a flat in a new build, the biggest risk is the developer. We help buyers — including foreigners — get their flat or their money back, through negotiation or in court.
- [How to register a business in Georgia as a foreigner](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/company-registration-in-georgia/): Foreigners can own 100% of a Georgian company and run it from abroad. We register LLCs, branches and individual entrepreneurs, prepare corporate documents and support you with banks, contracts and tax registration.
- [Work permit and sole trader status for foreigners in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/work-permit-and-sole-trader/): Since 1 March 2026, foreigners need the right to labour activity to work or do business in Georgia. We check whether it applies to you and sort out your status — from the permit to your taxes.
- [Residence permit in Georgia — lawyer for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/residence-permit-in-georgia/): We prepare and file residence permit applications for foreigners in Georgia, follow them through the Public Service Hall and appeal refusals.
- [Family lawyer for foreigners in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/family-law-for-foreigners/): Family cases with an international element follow their own rules. We help with divorce, child residence and alimony, and the recognition of foreign court decisions — in English or Russian.

## For Georgians living abroad

- [Legal help for Georgians living abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/): We handle your matter in Georgia without you having to travel — by power of attorney, remote consultations and constant contact on WhatsApp.
- [Accepting an inheritance in Georgia from abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/accepting-an-inheritance/): A family member has died in Georgia and you live abroad? You can accept the inheritance without coming — the key is not to miss the 6-month deadline.
- [Selling or buying property in Georgia from abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/selling-property-from-abroad/): Living abroad and need to sell, buy or rent out property in Georgia? We do it in your name — so that your money and your property stay protected.
- [Debts and enforcement in Georgia while you live abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/debts-and-enforcement/): Living abroad and found out you are on Georgia's debtors' register, or your property has been seized? We find out where the debt comes from and find a way out.
- [Restoring and keeping Georgian citizenship](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/restoring-georgian-citizenship/): Did you lose Georgian citizenship when you became a citizen of another country? The law gives a temporary chance to get it back until 1 January 2027 — without giving up your other citizenship.

## Crimes and penalties (Criminal Code of Georgia)

- [Crimes and penalties in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/): Short and clear: what each crime means, which article of the Criminal Code covers it, what the penalty is and what to do if you are accused or are a victim.
- [Theft in Georgia — Article 177: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/theft-article-177/): Secretly taking someone else's property. Penalties range from a fine to 10 years, depending on the damage and circumstances.
- [Robbery in Georgia — Article 178: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/robbery-article-178/): Openly taking someone else's property. Penalties range from a fine to 11 years, depending on the damage, violence and other factors.
- [Violent robbery in Georgia — Article 179](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/violent-robbery-article-179/): An attack to take property, with violence dangerous to life or health or the threat of it. Penalty: 5 to 15 years.
- [Extortion in Georgia — Article 181: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/extortion-article-181/): Demanding money or property under threat of violence, damage or spreading compromising information. Up to 9 years.
- [Embezzlement in Georgia — Article 182: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/embezzlement-article-182/): Unlawfully keeping or spending property or money you were entrusted with — often at work. Up to 11 years.
- [Damage to property in Georgia — Article 187](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/property-damage-article-187/): Damaging or destroying someone else's property causing significant damage. Penalties from a fine to 12 years.
- [Bodily harm in Georgia — Articles 117, 118, 120](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/bodily-harm/): Intentional minor, less serious and serious bodily harm — penalties from a fine to 14 years.
- [Hooliganism in Georgia — Article 239: penalties](https://mmlaw.ge/en/crimes/hooliganism-article-239/): A gross breach of public order with violence or the threat of violence. Penalties from a fine to 7 years.

- [Deportation from Georgia: grounds, deadlines and appeal](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/deportation-from-georgia/): When a foreigner can be expelled from Georgia, how the procedure works, how many days you have to appeal and what the temporary accommodation centre is.
- [Recognising a foreign court decision in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/recognition-of-foreign-judgments-georgia/): How to have a foreign divorce, alimony or other court decision recognised in Georgia: the Supreme Court, the documents you need and the grounds for refusal.
- [Divorce from abroad: without coming to Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/divorce-from-abroad-georgia/): How to divorce if you live abroad and married in Georgia: the consulate, court with a lawyer, a power of attorney and foreign court decisions.
- [Refused entry to Georgia: reasons and what to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/refused-entry-to-georgia/): Why foreigners are refused entry to Georgia, what to do at the border, whether you can appeal the decision and when it makes sense to try again.
- [Overstaying in Georgia: fines and entry bans](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/overstay-in-georgia-fines/): The fines and entry bans a foreigner faces for staying in Georgia after their lawful period ends — and how to avoid an overstay in the first place.
- [Work permit in Georgia for foreigners from 2026](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/work-permit-georgia/): Since 1 March 2026, foreigners need a right to work to be employed or run a business in Georgia. Who it applies to, what you need and what the risks are.
- [Individual entrepreneur in Georgia: the 1% tax for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/individual-entrepreneur-georgia-1-percent-tax/): How a foreigner registers as an individual entrepreneur in Georgia, gets small business status with the 1% tax, and what changed in 2026.
- [Power of attorney from abroad for use in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/power-of-attorney-from-abroad/): How to give a power of attorney from abroad for property, inheritance or court matters in Georgia: at a consulate or a local notary, apostille and translation.
- [Free criminal lawyer in Georgia: who qualifies](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/free-lawyer-legal-aid-georgia/): When the state pays for a defence lawyer in a Georgian criminal case, who counts as unable to pay, what mandatory defence means and how to ask for a lawyer.
- [How to choose a good lawyer in Georgia: 6 tips](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/how-to-choose-a-lawyer-in-georgia/): How to check a lawyer in the Georgian Bar Association registry, what to ask at the first meeting, how to agree the fee and which warning signs to watch for.
- [Fraud charges in Georgia: penalties and your defence](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/fraud-charges-in-georgia/): Fraud charges in Georgia: what counts as fraud, how the penalty depends on the amount of damage, and what to do if you are accused.
- [Theft charges in Georgia: penalties and your rights](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/theft-charges-in-georgia/): Theft charges in Georgia: how the value of property, breaking into a home and acting as a group affect the penalty, and what to do if accused.
- [Domestic violence charges in Georgia: what to know](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/domestic-violence-charges-georgia/): Domestic violence under Georgian law: who counts as a family member, the penalties, what makes a charge more serious, and what to do as accused or victim.
- [Drunk driving in Georgia: fines, licence, prison](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/drunk-driving-in-georgia/): Drunk driving rules in Georgia: alcohol limits, licence suspension, refusing a test, and when it becomes a criminal offence.
- [Bail or pre-trial detention in Georgia: how courts decide](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/bail-and-pretrial-detention-georgia/): How a Georgian court decides whether an accused stays in custody: types of preventive measures, bail, the detention limit and the 48-hour appeal.
- [Plea agreements in Georgia: when they're worth it](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/plea-agreement-in-georgia/): Plea agreements in Georgia: how they are made between the prosecution and the accused, what you gain, what you give up and what the court checks.
- [Arrested for drugs in Georgia: what to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/arrested-for-drugs-in-georgia/): What to do if you are arrested over drugs in Georgia: your rights, the search, drug testing, deadlines, possible penalties and mistakes to avoid.
- [Marijuana law in Georgia: what gets you fined?](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/marijuana-law-in-georgia/): The rules on marijuana in Georgia: small amounts, using it in public places, minors, and when it becomes a criminal offence.
- [Unfairly dismissed in Georgia? What to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/unlawful-dismissal-georgia/): What to do if you were unfairly dismissed in Georgia: asking for written grounds, documents, deadlines and what you can claim in court.
- [Accepting an inheritance in Georgia from abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/inheritance-from-abroad/): How to accept an inheritance in Georgia while living abroad: the 6-month deadline, power of attorney, documents and what happens if you missed the deadline.
- [Scammed online? How to try to get your money back](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/online-fraud-what-to-do/): What to do if you were scammed online in Georgia: your bank, evidence, reporting to the police — and the "money recovery" scammers.
- [How to appeal a fine in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/how-to-appeal-a-fine/): If you think a fine is unfair: where and how to appeal it in Georgia, what evidence to gather and which mistakes to avoid.
- [Buying an apartment in Georgia: what to check](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/buying-an-apartment-checklist/): What to check before buying an apartment in Georgia: the Public Registry extract, the seller, spouse consent, new builds and outstanding debts.
- [Registering an LLC in Georgia: what you need](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/how-to-register-llc-in-georgia/): How to register an LLC in Georgia: documents, legal address, charter, timing and what to do after registration — including for foreigners.
- [Residence permits in Georgia: which type do you need?](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/residence-permit-types-georgia/): The main types of residence permit in Georgia — work, business, property, family, study and investment — and how to choose the right one.
- [Police search in Georgia: your rights and what to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/police-search-your-rights/): What to know if your home or office is searched in Georgia: the court order, your lawyer, the search record and mistakes to avoid.
- [Child support (alimony) in Georgia: how the amount is set](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/alimony-in-georgia/): Who pays alimony in Georgia, how the amount is determined, how it can be changed and what happens if it isn't paid.
- [Detained in Georgia? Your rights and what to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/what-to-do-if-detained/): Your key rights if you are arrested in Georgia: the right to remain silent, to a lawyer, to an interpreter and to inform a relative — and the 48/72-hour rule.
- [Divorce in Georgia: civil registry or court?](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/divorce-in-georgia/): When you can divorce at the Public Service Hall and when only a court can decide — plus children, alimony and division of property in Georgia.
- [Who is a judge? Courts and judges in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/who-is-a-judge-in-georgia/): A judge is a person vested with the authority to hear and decide cases in court. How the court system in Georgia is organised and who can become a judge.
